name: Squirrel Sightings Map
purpose: Maps squirrel sightings by park area, time of day and fur colour

inputs.squirrel_id: ID given to each squirrel sighting
inputs.park_area: Grid square of the park the squirrel was seen in
inputs.time_of_day: Whether the squirrel was seen in the morning or the afternoon
inputs.fur_colour: Main colour of the squirrel's fur
inputs.age_group: Whether the squirrel is an adult or a juvenile
inputs.longitude: Longitude where the squirrel was seen
inputs.height_above_ground_ft: How high above the ground the squirrel was, in feet
inputs.weight_grams: Weight of the squirrel, in grams
inputs.observer_name: Name of the volunteer who saw the squirrel
